name: Cinematic
description: Slow, elegant, sweeping transitions that add drama and high premium feel.

name: Slow Burn
description: Extremely gradual, almost imperceptible reveals that demand patient attention.

name: Kinetic
description: Fast, punchy, mechanical animations fit for techno, brutalist, and modern cyber archetypes.

name: Elastic Bounce
description: High energy bounce that reacts physically to user inputs. Highly engaging and playful.

name: Reactive
description: Instant, responsive hover and micro-feedback that makes the site feel alive under the cursor.

name: Minimal
description: Barely-there fades and clean transitions that stay out of the way of content.

name: Springy Comfort
description: Smooth physical spring that provides an organic, responsive bouncing effect.

name: Fluid Flow
description: Slow, viscous liquid-like movement that is extremely relaxing and premium.
